purpose: Edge telemetry appliance for Asimov-Meter observations, reliability monitoring and robot-lab instrumentation.

compute.edge_compute: optional low-power SBC or industrial computer
compute.secure_element: required for device identity and signed update verification
compute.storage: encrypted industrial storage with write-integrity checks

safety.mains_power: use certified enclosed power supply; do not expose mains wiring
safety.overcurrent_protection: fuse or certified protected input module
safety.grounding: protective earth where required by the final enclosure and PSU
safety.thermal: independent thermal shutdown and airflow path
safety.firmware: signed updates, rollback image, secure boot where supported
safety.network: outbound allow-list, no default inbound administration
safety.data: encryption at rest, local retention policy, provenance on every reading

serviceability.cable_management: separate low-voltage signal and power routing

engineering_gate: Electrical and mechanical design must be reviewed by qualified engineers and tested to applicable standards before fabrication.
